title: Fix batch payment invoice selection functionality

requirements.text: Fix the invoice selector in BatchPaymentEntryPage to allow users to select multiple invoices from the same or different retailers for a single batch payment using RTGS or cheque payment mode

quotes: Not done changes as per request I am still not able to select batch payment I need to enter multiple invoice for single RTGS payment or cheque payment

acceptanceCriteria: User can navigate to batch payment entry page
User can search and select multiple unpaid or partially paid invoices
Selected invoices display with their details (retailer, invoice number, amount)
User can proceed to enter payment details for the selected batch

requirements.text: Ensure the BatchPaymentForm accepts and processes multiple selected invoices with a single RTGS payment mode, capturing transaction ID and payment date

quotes: I need to enter multiple invoice for single RTGS payment

acceptanceCriteria: User can select 'Online Transfer' payment mode for batch payment
Form displays transaction ID and date fields
Total amount across all selected invoices is calculated and displayed
Payment submission creates entries for all selected invoices with the same transaction reference

requirements.text: Ensure the BatchPaymentForm accepts and processes multiple selected invoices with a single cheque payment mode, capturing bank name, cheque number, and cheque date

quotes: I need to enter multiple invoice for single RTGS payment or cheque payment

acceptanceCriteria: User can select 'Cheque' payment mode for batch payment
Form displays bank name, cheque number, and cheque date fields
Total amount across all selected invoices is calculated and displayed
Payment submission creates entries for all selected invoices with the same cheque reference

requirements.text: Verify that the backend properly handles batch payment entries, updating invoice statuses and recording payment details for all invoices in the batch
acceptanceCriteria: Backend accepts payment entries with multiple invoice references
Invoice balances are updated correctly for each invoice in the batch
Payment history shows the batch payment for all affected invoices
Invoice status updates to 'Paid' when balance reaches zero

constraints: Must support both RTGS/online transfer and cheque payment modes for batch payments
Payment details (transaction ID or cheque info) must be consistent across all invoices in a batch
Do not modify authentication or role-based access control logic
nonGoals: Adding new payment modes beyond existing RTGS and cheque options
Modifying the invoice upload or template generation functionality
Changes to user management or admin features
